metadata.description: Algorhythm Inc. Claude Code plugins. html-deck-review: review tools for existing HTML pitch/IR decks.

plugins.name: html-deck-review
plugins.description: Review tools for HTML pitch/IR decks you already have: per-slide feedback panel with click-to-select regions, version-scoped feedback JSON, and a workflow that applies that version's feedback to the next version. Korean/English UI. Does not create decks.
